protocol:
(static damage; no re-adaptation): remove every candidate edge touching a node within `radius`
km of the centre, then count the city pairs still connected through the network. Centres closer than
radius+35 km to a city are skipped (those trivially isolate the city for every design).

paired_comparison.method: Resample seeds and shared zone indices; descriptive only, overlapping zones have spatial dependence; not a spatial confidence interval or superiority test
